items.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 19: Maruti Suzuki soars nearly 8%, Eicher Motors surges 5%, TCS falls 2%; check list

items.headline: The comeback club: ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance and Adani Port recovered up to 50% from their 52-week lows. What changed?
items.summary: Banking and Financial services names havee witnessed a sharp rally from their 52-week lows, primarily due to their robust earnings growth and valuation comfort at lower levels. In addition, all of these four stocks witnessed strong institutional activity in the last few quarters, delivering more than 30% returns

items.headline: Reliance, Hindustan Zinc and other metal stocks shine in Q2FY27 earnings; while auto sector faces pressure: Check key highlights
items.summary: The Q2FY27 earnings season which started in October 2026 served as one of key factors behind the broad-based market recovery. Q2 earnings performance was heavily mixed across sectors. Metals, oil and gas, and IT rebounded sharply, while Automobile sector posted lower profits due to soaring raw material costs.
